title: An $m$-Hessian approach to Yau uniformization conjecture
summary: We develop an \(m\)-Hessian approach to the construction of finite-Monge--Ampère weights on complete noncompact Kähler manifolds. Let \((M^n,g)\) be a complete noncompact Kähler manifold of complex dimension \(n\ge3\) with positive holomorphic bisectional curvature. The main new ingredient is a quantitative capacity mechanism based on lower-order complex Hessian operators.
